books.title: BRIMSTONE
books.author: Callie Hart
books.description: The second book in the Fae & Alchemy series. To save those close to them, Saeris and Fisher face a new set of dangers.

books.title: THE SEVEN RINGS
books.author: Nora Roberts
books.description: The third book in the Lost Bride Trilogy. Sonya fights across two realms to take possession of a haunted manor.

books.title: QUICKSILVER
books.author: Callie Hart
books.description: Saeris is transported to a dangerous land of ice and snow, where she must contend with a Fae warrior who has suspect agendas.

books.title: RETURN OF THE SPIDER
books.author: James Patterson
books.description: The 34th book in the Alex Cross series. An enemy’s murder book suggests Cross may have made rookie mistakes years ago.

books.title: THE WIDOW
books.author: John Grisham
books.description: When Simon Latch, a lawyer in rural Virginia, is accused of murder, he goes in search of the real killer.

books.title: THE SECRET OF SECRETS
books.author: Dan Brown
books.description: As he searches for the missing noetic scientist he has been seeing, Robert Langdon discovers something regarding a secret project.

books.title: NASH FALLS
books.author: David Baldacci
books.description: A successful businessman’s life is turned upside down when he is recruited by the F.B.I. to stop a large money laundering scheme.

books.title: THE BOND THAT BURNS
books.author: Briar Boleyn
books.description: The second book in the Bloodwing Academy series. When a dragon is awakened, bonds are tested and lives are threatened.

books.title: EXIT STRATEGY
books.author: Lee Child and Andrew Child
books.description: The 30th book in the Jack Reacher series. Reacher’s interest is piqued when he finds a handwritten note in his pocket.

books.title: ALCHEMISED
books.author: SenLinYu
books.description: After the war, an imprisoned alchemist is sent to a necromancer to recover her lost memories.

books.title: THE COLOR OF HOPE
books.author: Danielle Steel
books.description: A widowed art gallery owner moves to the Basque countryside, where she transforms a chateau and develops a new relationship.

books.title: THE CORRESPONDENT
books.author: Virginia Evans
books.description: Letters from someone she used to know push Sybil Van Antwerp toward revisiting her past and finding a way to forgive.
